row.evidence: Smartsheet's pricing comparison marks 'Directory integrations' and 'User account provisioning' for Enterprise and Advanced Work Management only (Enterprise is 'Custom pricing, 10+ Members'), and the Okta SCIM help article lists 'Plans: Enterprise'.
row.notes: Pro $9 and Business $19 per member/month billed yearly ($12 and $24 monthly); Enterprise and Advanced Work Management are custom pricing. Changes from June: the Business price on the pricing page is now $19/member/mo billed yearly (June row said $32), and the June '~$30-50/u/mo' Enterprise estimate had no first-party source, so it is dropped (scim_price_per_user_mo now null, multiplier null). June's note that SCIM permanently deletes users comes from Microsoft's Entra tutorial; Smartsheet's own help centre says deprovisioned users are deactivated, so behaviour follows Smartsheet's docs and the disagreement is in conflicts. SCIM must also be switched on by Smartsheet Support on an Enterprise plan. SAML SSO is Enterprise; 'Single sign-on (SSO)' on all plans refers to Google/Microsoft sign-in. REST API is Business and up, so API calls are not on the Pro team plan.

scim.notes: sso_required is false because the Okta guide makes SAML setup conditional ('If you're setting up SAML SSO'); SCIM must be enabled by Smartsheet Support and needs at least one validated domain.

auth.token_source: Smartsheet API access token generated by a System Admin under Account > Apps and Integrations > API Access > Generate new access token

operations.notes: Reactivation and full removal are done manually in Admin Center with Directory Integration temporarily turned off; Smartsheet's docs do not document a SCIM delete.

deprovision.data_retained: Account still exists and can be removed from the plan manually; items stay with the plan under Smartsheet's item ownership model.

attributes.notes: Smartsheet's own pages name only roles and the Division/Department/Cost Center fields; Microsoft's tutorial lists the full Entra mapping (see idp_apps.entra.notes).

roles.how: IdP group membership maps to Smartsheet roles via the SCIM roles attribute (LICENSED_USER, GROUP_ADMIN, RESOURCE_VIEWER, USER_ADMIN/PAYMENT_ADMIN/DATA_ADMIN, plus premium connector roles such as JIRA_USER, SALESFORCE_USER), which sets the seat type (Member or Contributor).

limitations.text: SCIM must be activated by Smartsheet Support or the account team on an Enterprise plan; at least one validated domain is required.
Deactivated users can only be reactivated by turning Directory Integration off, reactivating in Admin Center, then re-enabling it; the same applies to removing a user completely.
Guests are managed only in Admin Center; Directory Integration overrides manual seat changes on the next sync.
Only groups created in Okta can be pushed; existing Smartsheet groups cannot be synced.
Users managed by an IdP cannot be deactivated or removed through the REST API; the external source must be used.

capabilities.notes: POST /users adds the user if UAP rules match, otherwise invites; seat type is changed via plan upgrade/downgrade endpoints; role flags (admin, groupAdmin, licensedSheetCreator, resourceViewer) are user attributes updated with PUT /users/{userId}.

endpoints.purpose: List users in the organization account
Add user to the organization account
List plans the user belongs to
Upgrade user seat type on a plan
Downgrade user seat type on a plan
Remove user from plan (deactivate plan membership)

rate_limits.text: 300 requests per minute per API token for most operations (10x cost for attachments and cell history).

limitations.text: The API is restricted to Business and Enterprise plans.

okta.notes: 'Smartsheet SCIM' OIN app marks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push and Group Linking (read from page markup). A separate 'Smartsheet' (V2) app is for domain-level SAML.

entra.notes: Microsoft's attribute mapping: userName, active, title, name.givenName, name.familyName, phoneNumbers (work, mobile, fax), emails[type eq "work"].value, externalId, roles, enterprise department, division, costCenter, manager; userName supports filtering.

google.notes: Google's guide uses a Smartsheet API access token; it does not say whether it calls SCIM or the REST API.

onelogin.notes: Smartsheet's OneLogin help article covers Brandfolder only; OneLogin's connector page was not checked (bot challenge).

fallbacks.other_sync: User Auto-Provisioning (UAP): users with an email on a validated plan domain are added automatically.

conflicts.text: Microsoft's Entra tutorial says Smartsheet does not support soft-deletes and permanently deletes a user when active is set to false; Smartsheet's help centre says deprovisioned users are deactivated and their accounts still exist. Smartsheet's docs are used for behaviour.

open_questions: Smartsheet's docs do not publish SCIM ServiceProviderConfig/Schemas, filtering, pagination or SCIM-specific rate limits.
Whether SCIM deprovisioning ends active sessions is not documented.
Whether Google Workspace autoprovisioning uses SCIM or the REST API is not stated.
Enterprise price is not public; the 10+ member minimum is the only published gate.
API access token expiry for the SCIM token is not documented.
Whether SAML sign-in creates accounts just-in-time (separate from UAP) was not confirmed.
OneLogin catalogue entry for Smartsheet (not Brandfolder) was not verified.
